decisions: Your week (26 Oct): Mon double tonight (5:30pm class + 6:30pm WL), Tue and Wed mornings only, Wed is a 5:30–7:30am double. Thu, Sat and Sun as usual.

Thursday is HSPU-heavy (strict and kipping HSPU in gymnastics, 10 strict HSPU a round in comp B). Keep every set crisp and cap the comp-class HSPU. Sunday's EMOM stays, but if the shoulders are sore Sunday, do handstand holds and the MU drills only.

Press Monday, bench Tuesday, as Jason wrote it (about 13 hours apart). Bench is the lift that failed, so it gets Tuesday morning with nothing pressing before it in that session. Last week it failed straight after ring work. The press is only 3 × 5 @ 54.
Row W1 S1 goes in the Wed double after WL, instead of the 6:30am class. It's been missed two weeks running. It's pacing work at +2 s, so it's fine after the back squats.
Mon class comes before WL, so keep it at 60–70% (Jason's note) to protect the lifts and the POLP.
Row W1 S2 is after Sat WL. If Saturday won't happen, do it at Fri open gym instead.
No extra front squat accessory work this week. Saturday's pause front squat covers it, and the Wed double is full.
HSPU EMOM stays at 8 × 3 because last Sunday was missed. Sunday is furthest from both the Mon press and the Sat jerks.
POLP: Mon deadlift wk3 + press wk6, Tue bench wk6 (repeat 94), Wed back squat wk7 (Phase 2). Max 2 a day; bench and press on different days. Skip any POLP bench in Thursday's comp class.
The endurance track is skipped (bike, pyramid cycle, Run Endurance, class Row W7). You're on Row W1, and running is parked until after the comp.

Class WODs come from the gym blog this week (no Competitors PDF in Slack), condensed rather than word for word. Mon: skip part A (POLP deadlift is in WL), do B at 60–70%. Tue: bench isn't in the class, so do POLP bench before class. Wed and Sat Performance are skipped.

streams.label: HSPU skill + ring MU drills
streams.text:
About 40 minutes at open gym, the week's skill session.

1. Shoulder warm-up + 2 × 20 s wall-facing handstand hold
2. Strict HSPU EMOM 8 min × 3 reps (24 reps). Stop the EMOM as soon as a rep slows. No grinders, no kipping.

→ Still 3s, because last Sunday was missed. Move to 5s only once every minute is crisp.

Then ring muscle-up drills (about 10 min):
3. Kip swings on rings: 3 × 6. Tight hollow/arch, feet stay under you.
4. False-grip kip to hips: 3 × 3. Pull the rings back to your hips, no turnover.
5. Low-ring transitions: 3 × 5
